commit.subject: watchdog: couple bounded efficient readings
commit.body:
Cache unchanged closed-record scans behind mutation-sensitive input fingerprints, stream lexical held-output checks including raw.out, and propagate store enumeration errors to the tick guard. Read the forge on a configurable cadence with bounded commands, a bounded page, and explicit fresh, cached, full-page, and unavailable readings.

Grok 4.6 supplied the source audit findings and did not review this implementation.

Source: original
Co-Authored-By: GPT-5 Codex <noreply@openai.com>
